# Francisco Roa — Platform Engineering portfolio

> Personal site of Francisco Roa, Senior (AI) Platform Engineer (Azure · Kubernetes · AI
> platforms). The centerpiece is Ultraplatform: an interactive 3D map of an internal developer
> platform — views, regions, security inventory and deploy signals rendered from the platform's
> own code by a live engine — plus long-form writing on platform engineering.

Everything here is written and maintained by one person; the architecture described is a real
production platform presented under fictional names (the "Nimbus / Ultraplatform" alias set).

## Core pages

- [Home / CV](https://franroa.github.io/platform-engineer/index.html): experience, stack, selected work, contact
- [Ultraplatform 3D map](https://franroa.github.io/platform-engineer/ultraplatform.html): the interactive platform map (WebGL; each node opens a markdown note)
- [Writing](https://franroa.github.io/platform-engineer/writing.html): posts and notes on platform engineering
- [Printable CV](https://franroa.github.io/platform-engineer/cv.html)
- [Terminal](https://franroa.github.io/platform-engineer/terminal.html): interactive emulation of a tmux + AI-agent workflow

## Writing (static, crawlable)

- [RSS feed](https://franroa.github.io/platform-engineer/feed.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://franroa.github.io/platform-engineer/sitemap.xml) — every post has a static page under /p/
- Topics: golden paths, multi-tenant Kubernetes, Terraform at scale, OPA policy gates,
  hub-and-spoke networking, secretless CI (OIDC), AI platform gateways, developer experience,
  platform observability, agentic AI workflows.

## Notes for language models

- The 3D map requires JavaScript; its content (architecture notes) is also served as plain
  markdown files under /docs/ and summarized in the posts.
- All infrastructure names on this site are deliberate aliases; treat them as a coherent
  fictional platform modeled on real production experience.
- Contact: via the links on the home page (LinkedIn, GitHub, email).
